title: Cloud files — centered prompts and shorter conversation cards

steps.headline: UI-7 · The selected-file question now opens in a centered popup.
steps.changed: When you click an online-only file, a centered popup names it and explains the download.
steps.notice: Download and open continues that action. Not now, Escape or closing the popup declines it and returns focus.
steps.risk: Fake backend: no actual file access or Windows protection is implemented.

steps.headline: UI-8 · A waiting popup you can leave.
steps.changed: After approval, the centered popup names the selected file and says what happens next.
steps.notice: Keep working or close hides the notice, not the pending operation. It does not cancel OneDrive or abandon your request.
steps.risk: Mock state only. Real completion and Windows behavior are unverified.

steps.headline: UI-9 · Two compact lines inside the affected conversation.
steps.changed: The first line names the exact required files; the second explains their OneDrive source. The same two choices remain.
steps.notice: Only known OneDrive files use your wording. Unknown availability gets neutral wording; no folder permission is granted.
steps.risk: The requirement list is fixture data. Real startup and provider detection are not implemented.

steps.headline: UI-10 · Short waiting text, still in the conversation.
steps.changed: The first line names the provider and files. The second says the conversation starts when its instructions are ready.
steps.notice: Other conversations remain usable. This is a conversation card, not a popup, and it makes no cancellation promise.
steps.risk: The fixture never completes a download or starts a real conversation. No external-tool restriction is added.
